name: Queen Ehlissa’s Marvelous Nightingale

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight. Reference-only powers are described in text and have no action button.

summary: Reference-only: Magic action activates the bird’s song for 10 minutes (audible 300 feet), or ends it early; after reverting, wait 1 hour to reactivate.
text: Reference-only: Magic action activates the bird’s song for 10 minutes (audible 300 feet), or ends it early; after reverting, wait 1 hour to reactivate. Six charges; regain 1d6+1 at dawn. While singing within 60 feet, Bonus Action casts at DC 18: Detect Evil and Good or Speak with Animals (0), Calm Emotions (1), Slow (2), Compulsion (3), Greater Restoration (4), Delayed Blast Fireball or Prismatic Spray (6). While singing, a 15-foot Emanation acts as Zone of Truth (DC 18); you know save outcomes. Reaction casts Counterspell (DC 18) while singing, once per dawn. Random properties: two minor beneficial, one major beneficial, one minor detrimental. Destroy by releasing it into a whirlwind in Limbo.
